title: fix(cli): `os lint` warns on every bare package-authored metadata name, and `os generate` writes them prefixed
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D9HSxC7WngZADjXgb6UHCVp)_

domain:devx#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cyadQ5Zhih2y1GNTQm

Part of #30804
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:`os lint` 的 `naming/namespace-prefix` 从「只报包内重名」扩为「每个裸的包内元数据名都报」(28 类),`fix` 给出 `<ns>_<name>`;`os generate` 写出的脚手架名同步带前缀。
- **为什么改**:裁决 C(#30798「同意 c」)——包作者写的每个元数据名都带命名空间;本 PR 是第二阶段的 lint 一半,示例与模板改名在 PR 2。
- **风险与回滚**:仍是 warning,不拒收;只有 `os lint --strict` 会因它失败，仓内没有 CI 车道这样跑示例。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**:① `lint.ts` 的 `namespacePrefixIssues` 与 `NAME_JUDGED_ELSEWHERE`(豁免表);② `project-namespace.ts` 的 `carriesPackageNamespace`(lint 与 generate 共用的一个判定)。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run test/lint-namespace-prefix.test.ts`;或在 `examples/app-todo` 跑 `os lint`,看 20 条新警告各带 `fix`。
- **需要你做的**:裁一个开放问题——`showcase.export_data` 这类点号能力名是否算已带命名空间(本 PR 默认算，见 Acceptance notes)。

## What changes

**`naming/namespace-prefix` warns on every bare package-authored name.** In a package that declares `manifest.namespace`, every top-level item in every manifest collection (`PLURAL_TO_SINGULAR`, 28 of its 31 keys) whose `name` does not carry the namespace gets one warning. The message states the contract, and the `fix` is the rename:

```text
⚠ Flow "onboard" does not carry the package namespace "crm". Every metadata name a package authors starts with its namespace, as object names do, so that no two installed packages can hold the same name — rename it to "crm_onboard" and update every reference that spells it.
```

The judged collections are apps, pages, dashboards, reports, datasets, actions, flows, jobs, positions, permissions, capabilities, sharingRules, queues, assignmentRules, apis, webhooks, agents, tools, skills, ragPipelines, hooks, mappings, picklists, analyticsCubes, connectors, datasources, emailTemplates and books. The set is derived from the spec map, so a collection added there is judged the day it lands.

**What is not judged, and why** (`NAME_JUDGED_ELSEWHERE` plus the predicate):

| Not judged | Reason |
|:--|:--|
| `objects` | `defineStack`'s `validateNamespacePrefix` already refuses a bare object name |
| `views` | a container is named for its bound object; a view item is `<object>.<key>` |
| `docs` | the doc lint's own `docs/namespace-prefix` error |
| object / picklist extensions, translations, fields, `functions` | not in the collection map: each names the item it extends, has no name of its own, is keyed inside its object, or is a code handler |
| an item that declares `overrides` | ADR-0146 D2: it replaces the base package's item of the same name |
| a package with no `manifest.namespace` | nothing to prefix with, the object rule's posture |

A name **carries** the namespace when it is the namespace itself (the ADR-0019 namespace-named app), starts with `<ns>_`, starts with `<ns>.` (the dotted capability shape `CapabilitySchema` documents, `billing.refund`), or starts with the platform-reserved `sys_`. That is one predicate, `carriesPackageNamespace` in `utils/project-namespace.ts`.

**The duplicate finding stays**, under the same rule id, for any name declared twice in one package, prefixed or not (apps, pages, dashboards, flows, reports, datasets, and actions on their `objectName:name` key). It no longer offers the prefixed spelling as its rename, because the new finding carries that, and its message no longer says the prefix is "an optional convention". It now has no `fix`.

**`os generate` writes prefixed names (bounded in-place fix, accepted by the seat).** Before, only object names got the prefix, so in a namespaced project `os g flow onboard` wrote `onboard_flow`, and the new warning fired on a fresh scaffold. Now the action, flow, dashboard, app, skill, picklist, permission set and dataset generators write `<ns>_…` through `namespacedItemName`, which uses the same predicate, so a scaffold is never written in a spelling the lint reports. A name that already carries the namespace is never doubled. The namespace is now read for every generator. The refusal when the config does not load still applies only to `namesObject` generators, because a bare non-object name is a warning and not a refusal. The `namesObject` flag still means "writes an object name".

**Changeset:** `'@objectstack/cli': patch`.

## Why

Ruling C on #30798 (maintainer, verbatim 「同意 c」): every package-authored metadata name carries its namespace, phased. Two installed packages that share a bare name such as `send_email` often resolve to only one of them, silently. This is phase 2's lint half. Phase 1 (#30803) is the registration backstop, phase 3 (#30806) turns it into a refusal, and #30805 covers the skills. PR 2 of this card renames the examples and templates.

## Acceptance notes

- **Open question for a ruling (dotted capability names).** app-showcase declares `showcase.export_data` and `showcase.restricted_ops` in namespace `showcase`. CapabilitySchema's name regex admits a dot, and its own example is `billing.refund`. This PR treats `<ns>.` as carrying the namespace. Its test has a twin: `billing.refund` under namespace `crm` still warns. If the ruling is strict `<ns>_` only, the dotted clause comes out of `carriesPackageNamespace`, and PR 2 renames the two capabilities and their three `requiredPermissions` references. Phase 3 (#30806) needs the same answer.
- **Open question for phase 3: `functions`.** They are not in the collection map, so this rule does not judge them. The audit behind #30798 named function handlers as a collision class, so #30806 may want them in its refusal.
- **Baseline bare-name counts under this rule** (origin/main `100303c0`, before PR 2). Duplicates are 0 everywhere.

  | Config | Bare | By type |
  |:--|--:|:--|
  | `examples/app-todo` | 20 | actions 8, reports 5, flows 4, dashboards 1, datasets 1, hooks 1 |
  | `examples/app-crm` | 7 | positions 3, dashboards 1, datasets 1, permissions 1, hooks 1 |
  | `examples/app-showcase` | 12 | positions 10, sharingRules 2 (14 under a strict `<ns>_` reading: plus capabilities 2) |
  | `examples/app-multi-package` | 1 | apps 1 (`multi_crm` in package `crm`, so the fix is `crm_multi_crm`) |
  | `create-objectstack` blank template | 0 | only `blank_note`; every other barrel is empty |
  | `examples/embed-objectql` | 0 | declares no manifest namespace |

- **No CI lane turns these warnings red.** The rule is reached only through `lintConfig` (`os lint`, `os lint --eval`), never from `os validate`, `os build` or `os compile`. `os lint` exits 1 on warnings only under `--strict`, and nothing in `.github/workflows`, `scripts/` or the example and template `package.json` files passes it. `check:i18n-coverage` counts only `i18n/` rules. The tests that lint real examples filter to their own rule or assert exit 0. A warning costs 3 points of the `os lint` score, and no example's score is pinned.
- **Pins this PR changes on purpose.** The old tests asserted that a bare name is silent, and those assertions are rewritten. `generate-object-namespace-prefix.test.ts`'s census of #20197 ("prefixes every object name, and only object names") now expects every scaffold's own name prefixed. Its `namesObject` derivation holds the scaffold's own name fixed, except on the object scaffold. `generate-scaffold-validates.test.ts`'s #21325 binding check pins the scaffold's own `name` on its own and searches only the rest of the artifact for a stray object reference. `generate-stack-reach.test.ts` expects `my_app_approve` / `my_app_approval_changed_flow`.
- **ADR-0048 §5's lint bullet** is out of date. Per the seat's route, it is corrected in its own one-file `docs/adr` PR (Tier H), not here.
- **Out of scope here:** `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md:121` still describes the old rule (#30805). `content/docs/ui/doc-pages.mdx` L70–83 says the prefix is "no longer load-bearing for uniqueness" (PR 2's docs pass).

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (`packages/spec` not touched.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (eslint `--no-inline-config` on every changed file: exit 0.)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (n/a)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.

## Verification

All at head `c4ad5c80` (origin/main `d996c381` merged in).

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run` (unit + integration projects): 590 files passed, 1 skipped; 7272 tests passed, 9 skipped.
- The nightly e2e tier (`OS_TEST_TIERS=nightly`) on the 19 files that generate, scaffold, init or lint (`generate-*.e2e`, `init-created-files-summary.e2e`, `scaffold-emission-policy.e2e`, `starter-field-consumers.e2e`, `jsx-gate-manifest-notice.e2e`, `lint-*.e2e`): 19 files, 250 tests, all passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit` and `check:test-typecheck`): exit 0. The test layer needed `--max-old-space-size=8192`, because it ran out of heap at the default.
- eslint `--no-inline-config` on the 9 changed `.ts` files: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:liveness`: exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: exit 0, 61 commands, all run, all exit 0. Two first exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET) and went green on a re-run once the prerequisite was met. `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` needed its pinned fixture commit fetched into the shallow clone. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` needed 7 packages built (studio, client-react, embedder-openai, knowledge-memory, knowledge-ragflow, service-cluster-redis, service-knowledge). `--ran` reconciliation: exit 0, 61 derived, 61 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED.
